newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KOGER AND SUMBERG 22.5 MLN KROON ISSUE READY.
newsitem.headline: KOGER AND SUMBERG 22.5 MLN KROON ISSUE READY.

text.p: Koger and Sumberg, the third largest construction company in Estonia, is to organise a 22.5 million kroons share issue from August 18, Hansa Investments said on Monday.
"The company will issue 375,040 new shares with a face value of 10 kroons and a sale price of 60 kroons," Piret Raudsepp, project officer with Hansa Investments, told Reuters.
The public share issue will close on September 1.
Raudsepp also said that with the listing the construction company will broaden its shareholder base as part of its move to seek a listing on the Tallinn stock exchange.
"The sale of the shares is aimed at the local market," she added.
Koger and Sumberg's 1996 total turnover was 258 million kroons compared to 1995's 154 million kroons.
The company's 1996 net profit was 100,000 kroons with 1997's profit estimate set at eight million kroons.
EMV and Merko, the two largest construction companies in Estonia, are already traded on the Tallinn stock exchange.
